home.timeBankDetail: Each player also has 2 minutes for the whole game, used once a turn’s time runs out. Time left over from a turn is added, up to 3 minutes.

home.penaltiesDetail: 101 points for discarding the okey or a tile that fits the table, and for an okey taken from your set; the discard’s number ×10 when the next player opens with it.
